question: Can full completion silently refuse all unchanged inherited work after F3/F4?
finding: No. That would regress accepted F2 end-to-end behavior and fail regression/Controls acceptance. Scope-only preserved positives do not prove real completion remains usable.
evidence: tools/workflow_assurance.py assess_repository complete global drift checks and _receipt_candidate selective protected input checks

observed_diagnostic.tracked: Global assessor rejects unselected inherited other.txt bytes; same complete selected identity passes _receipt_candidate.
observed_diagnostic.untracked_symlink: Global assessor rejects inherited untracked paths; same selected identity passes _receipt_candidate without following an unrelated dangling link.
observed_diagnostic.limitation: This is diagnostic API evidence only, not an observed full new-proof completion or QA pass. First capture wrapper had a metadata NameError; retained failure record and reran properly as attempt2.

required_positive_fixture: Actual bugfix/small-change begin with unrelated tracked dirty bytes, unrelated untracked bytes and/or unrelated symlink; immutable base records their separate identities. Pinned selected material contains changed scoped source plus actual loaded verifier/schema/authorization inputs. Produce actual bound captures, then real done exits0 while inherited endpoints remain identical. Mutating an inherited endpoint afterwards must refuse real done.
recommended_boundary: Preserve historical assess_repository global fail-closed behavior and its existing rejection tests. If introducing a route-specific assessed-manifest producer, retain same identity wire shape and explicitly require trusted consumed base/scope/contract, independently derive context/inventory, verify_actual_changed_scope, every original inherited endpoint comparison, and exact current/index/anchor identities for selected material inputs. Permit unrelated inherited exclusions only through that bounded task-base rule, never arbitrary global skips or unchecked ignore lists. Selected dependencies must not intersect inherited exclusions. Expose/document this supported producer path and execute it in positive fixtures; hand-built manifest-only success is insufficient usability evidence.
implementation_assessment: Current contract does not mandate the global assessor as the only producer. A route-specific producer within existing source files can satisfy candidate/inventory/context requirements without weakening the existing global API. If implementation changes global assessment or adds broader exclusions, return for contract review.
